headline: Rp5 T Gap: Pension Fund Benefit Payments Exceed Contribution Receipts
summary: Indonesia's pension fund industry faces an imbalance, with benefit payments exceeding contribution receipts by about Rp 5 trillion, according to the report.
why: Pension funds manage long-term retirement savings and invest heavily in bonds and equities, so funding gaps can affect domestic capital markets.
original_headline: Selisih Rp5 T, Pembayaran Duit Pensiun Dapen Lampaui Penerimaan Iuran
